draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.14, the 104th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 16th of 35 at WR. He went 56th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (104th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Jacoby Ford. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 784 receiving yards in 2020, 13th of 35 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2025. 43 career games and 0 starts over 5 completed seasons. Producing near his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 1 in 2021. Weak spots: receiving yards 62 (12th percentile), team target share 1.5% (13th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 wide receiver who played: 62 receiving yards against a median of 255, below the norm.
